instruction: Candid cinematic still, medium close-up. Outdoors in a sunny grassy field, friends sit together. In the foreground, the man in the olive shirt (R3) embraces the red-haired woman (R2) from behind. The red-haired woman, in a black off-shoulder top, smiles softly, while the man in the olive shirt looks directly forward with a gentle smile. In the left background, the man with glasses (R4) sits in a striped shirt, looking away. Warm natural sunlight bathes the scene, creating soft shadows and a shallow depth of field.
elements: R2 is the person receiving the behind-the-back embrace from R3
R3 is behind R2 in the foreground contact pair
R4 sits in the background looking away while R2 and R3 are the foreground contact pair
